_comment: blewatch config. trusted_devices may be a bare list of addresses or a map addr -> {name, services, mitm}. All addresses are case-insensitive, MSB-first (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff).
_tuning_comment: Flood/churn counts are per logical advertising event over the window, tuned for a full-coverage nRF52 sniffer. channel_dedup_window_s (seconds) collapses the 37/38/39 copies of one event so a healthy beacon is not counted 3x. Lower the counts for a quiet site, raise them for a crowded one.
